The sync succeeded. I ran it for Google, activity category only, with a 2-day overlap. All 10 requests completed without errors.

- **Records:** 3 updated, 0 new, 0 unchanged, 0 restored, 0 marked as deleted upstream.
- **Window:** The job reported 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-07 (America/New_York), which is wider than 2 days. That is probably because the last sync was earlier than that. I didn't verify this.
- **Dates:** The sync data ends on 2026-10-07. The system clock shows early November, so nothing newer than 10-07 came back. That could mean no newer data exists or the window just stopped there. I didn't check which.
- **Scope:** I synced only the activity category. I didn't sync sleep, heart or other categories, and I didn't pull intraday data or whole-day heart rate. I can run those if you want.
- **Token:** Your Google token is active. While the consent screen is in Testing mode, refresh tokens expire after 7 days. If a later sync fails on authorization, run `ghealth auth login`.
